criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish realized AI revenue excluding OpenAI below $3 billion in the target quarter and approximately $293 billion of consistently defined AI-related capital expenditure over the stated four-year span.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish quarterly AI revenue excluding OpenAI of at least $3 billion, or spending materially inconsistent with approximately $293 billion under the same scope and period.
